perfil.titular: Multiplatform developer in training · 2nd year of DAM
perfil.claim: I build Android apps and APIs that people actually use. Looking for an internship for 2027.
perfil.presentacion: Second-year DAM student in Valencia. Kotlin, Spring Boot and whatever it takes to ship the project; currently learning to work with AI agents from specifications.
sobreMi: I'm in my second year of DAM and I enjoy solving problems more than arguing about frameworks. I've built Android apps, a Spring Boot API and several websites, almost always for specific people: my class, a friend's shop, the school.

I'm now learning to work with AI agents from specifications: writing down what I want properly before anyone, human or machine, writes a line of code. I'm looking for an internship where I can learn from a real team.
ahora: Finishing the 2nd year of DAM at IES Ejemplo (Valencia)
